cbt_recommendation.goal: To help the client reframe their catastrophic predictions about completing the project and to build a more balanced perspective on potential outcomes.

plan.Examine feared outcomes: Discuss the impact of these outcomes and what they believe would happen if those fears became reality.
plan.Evaluate likelihood and evidence: Explore how likely these feared outcomes actually are, using evidence and past experiences to support their evaluation.
plan.Generate realistic outcomes: Help the client come up with more realistic scenarios that could occur instead of the catastrophic ones.
plan.Create coping/homework practice: Assign the client to keep a journal of their predictions and outcomes as they work through their project, noting any discrepancies between predicted fears and actual results.
